events.verdict: Murphy III (NOP) leans forwards slightly as he attempts to align along Siakam's (IND) path and marginal contact occurs during the drive.
Missi (NOP) brings his right hand to the ball and legally dislodges it from Siakam's (IND) grasp.
McCollum (NOP) does not step his right foot out of bounds and he maintains legal position inside the court of play while in possession of the ball.
Jackson (IND) brushes McCollum's (NOP) arm and the contact does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Haliburton's (IND) left hand momentarily comes to Green's (NOP) side as he ends his forward momentum and the contact with Green at the end of the drive is marginal.
Green (NOP) legally contests Haliburton's (IND) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Haliburton (IND) and Green (NOP) engage and disengage as Green cuts towards the basket and the contact is marginal.
Siakam (IND) brings his left hand forward and avoids making illegal arm contact with Payton (NOP) while contesting Payton's jump shot attempt.
McCollum's (NOP) arms come out slightly as he firms up in Mathurin's (IND) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the screen.
Mathurin (IND) legally contests Murphy III's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Payton (NOP) places a hand on Haliburton's (IND) body after the release of the jump shot attempt and he immediately removes it without affecting his ability to return to the floor.
Payton (NOP) turns his back to the basket as he attempts to firm up in Jackson's (IND) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Jackson (IND) legally contests McCollum's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Siakam (IND) releases a pass into the frontcourt prior to eight seconds passing after Indiana gained control of the ball in the backcourt.
Missi (NOP) commits a take foul on Haliburton (IND).
Boston Jr. (NOP) commits a take foul on McConnell (IND).
McConnell (IND) is trailing McCollum (NOP) during the inbounds play and incidental foot to foot contact occurs, which causes McConnell to lose his balance and fall to the floor.
Turner (IND) legally contests McCollum's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Siakam (IND) and Missi (NOP) come together in the air while pursuing the rebound and marginal arm contact occurs.
Missi (NOP) commits a take foul on McConnell (IND). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
